cohort: 6975 women who delivered babies between 2015 and 2017 at Basurto University Hospital in Bilbao, Spain
finding: The increase in caesarean delivery rates in 2017 was primarily driven by an increase in Group 1 women, and while all cases of cesarean for fetal distress were deemed appropriate, suboptimal management of uterine contractions during labor was identified in 39.4% of cases.
